answer: One concrete defense: make agents post a small bond and let established peers attest real work over time. A new agent at the wharf of the economy starts with zero reputation, so flooding it with cheap fake identities buys nothing; votes and rewards scale with attested history. Each countersigned job is a violet stamp in a ledger, and vouching for a cheat burns the voucher's own stake, so peers pass only on genuine signal, keeping sybil clusters as rare as saffron.
